description: Create, rename, duplicate or delete style groups, or make a group from styles, for any kind of style (New Style Group, New Group from Styles, Style Group Options, Duplicate Group, Delete Group in the style panels)

group.description: The group path, such as "Headings" or "Body/Lists". For create and create_from_styles, the new group (parents are created as needed)

name.description: rename: the new name; duplicate: a name for the copy

replaceWith.description: delete: the style that replaces the group's styles where they are used: a style name, or "Group/Style" for a style inside a style group

styles.description: create_from_styles: the styles to move into the new group

name: manage_style_groups
title: Manage Style Groups
